evidence.decision: Distinguishes deliberate presses from incidental taps and chooses Back behavior from hierarchy and task state, preserving system Home, media and guide-button meanings.
evidence.artifact: Requires a state-by-button/gesture map and revised interaction artifact covering browse, play, scrub, pause and return routes.
evidence.transformation: The streaming example removes pause-on-any-clickpad-tap and recent-screen Back, retaining deliberate playback controls and a predictable episode-to-show parent route.
evidence.verification: Walks state transitions and rejects incidental playback changes, stranded or surprising Back exits and unrelated program-guide actions; hardware gestures and across-room feedback remain unverified by keyboard simulation.
evidence.applicability: Is explicitly tvOS-specific and distinguishes normal browsing, gameplay pause/resume and electronic-program-guide versus active-playback page behavior.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Focus and Selection for directional reachability and Game Controls for controller/menu consistency.
evidence.distinctiveness: Press-then-swipe scrubbing, parent-versus-history Back, held-Back Home and page-buttons-as-channel-change during playback make a concrete remote interaction procedure.
